loaded_identity_comparison.limitation: Matching loaded base/adapter hashes, package/source identities and math flags bind inspected values. They do not fix every runtime state, GPU kernel/autotuning selection, generated code or allocation lifetime; no such unobserved mechanism is identified as the cause.

r5.order: A8 forwards then B5; no backward; original A-only inference-reference prelude retained

r6.order: A N0/R0/G0,one A backward,B5 then A5; A later N1 contains the backward plus intervening B5 history

r7.order: A N0/R0/G0,one A backward,A legacy/candidate/restored triples then B same triples; candidate bypass only N/R,original G restored

conclusions: R5 and R7 match exactly for all6 corresponding A/B N/R/G LP vectors and hidden identities. R6 differs from both for every corresponding primary group, including both G vectors and both reference vectors.
Therefore G is not universally unchanged across runs. It repeats within the observed runs and between R5/R7, but R6 is a real counterexample to cross-run G invariance.

R6 A pre/post G and R match exactly while N changes (max0.130251646); that A post observation follows both one backward and B5 forwards. R7 A pre/post all3 kinds match exactly. Backward alone is not established as a deterministic cause.
B has no same-run R6/R7 pre-backward control and preceding A histories differ. The cross-run comparison cannot isolate action order, backward or bypass as the unique cause.
Preserve all three observations; identical loaded identity records do not justify relabeling R6 as invalid or claiming generated code is the root cause.
No loss-anchor, precision or learning-rate recommendation or new model benefit follows from this evidence integration.
